acceptedDifferences: Overload.UI / Overload.EventSystems / Overload.Maths namespaces; no UnityEngine binary compatibility.
Actor/Behaviour lifecycle and session ownership replace UnityEngine.Object and MonoBehaviour.
AssetRef and epoch-validated component handles replace Unity object pointers.
Session-owned update/tween scheduling replaces MonoBehaviour coroutines.
Editor-only inspectors and menus excluded; Overload editor equivalents remain required.
